description: Automatically switch airplane mode on a schedule Features • Flexible schedules. Run once or repeat on the days you choose. • Overnight schedules. A schedule can continue into the next day. • Full control. Skip, postpone, pause or end a schedule at any time. • Wi-Fi control. Turn off Wi-Fi when a schedule starts, and turn it back on when it ends. • Safe by default. Ending a schedule only reverts changes the app made. • Notifications. Quiet notifications before, during and after a schedule. • No internet access, ads or tracking ever. Requirements • Android 9 or later. • Non-root: Shizuku-Next (recommended) or Shizuku. • Root: Magisk or another root access manager, Sui, or Shizuku/Shizuku-Next as root.
